test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six members in a family. P is the husband of Q. U is the brother of Q. R is the son of the only brother of Q. S is the sister of T. P is the father of S. How is U related to T?
solution:
Family chart :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749b5b689090c8a303af7be8d3e16c0fd60e1068fd8dc460dddfc628895fff49.png] 

**Family Tree :**

1) P is the husband of Q and U is the brother of Q and R is the son of the only brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/556208f3054e1cfd360649acab711c5e70696318b2640d47295b347feb6060c0.png] 

2) P is the father of S and S is the sister of T. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1725993784e83523a497184988c9b3ab6bc100944c6949050d27579f06d56fbf.png] 

∴ Here, U is Maternal uncle of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Maternal uncle".**
